comparator.route: Spanish Language and Culture specialisation with two supplementary Spanish minors and the standard third-year Spanish-speaking study abroad
comparator.sourceNotes: This normalized target is the Spanish Language and Culture specialisation within Romance Languages and Cultures, not a generic humanities bachelor. Official prospective year pages give 60+60+60=180 EC. Year one consists of 60 EC compulsory Spanish language acquisition (four 5-EC courses), Spanish/Hispanic culture, media, literature, linguistics and humanities study; two 0-EC mentoring/language-skill units are omitted. Year two has 30 EC compulsory Spanish language, linguistics, culture and literature, plus two required 15-EC arts minors. The route selects supplementary Spanish minor 1 and 2 in published order, each consisting of three 5-EC courses; the alternative 5-EC Academicus voor de klas course is unselected. Year three consists of a compulsory 15-EC Spanish-speaking study abroad component, a 5-EC Hispanic major course, 30 EC genuinely open free space and a 10-EC bachelor thesis. The abroad major component and free space remain separate even where some free courses are taken abroad. The prospective year pages form a coherent indicative cohort sequence; final course availability and requirements should be checked against the applicable catalogue.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The cultural programme is the strongest related-fields response to the target’s literature, culture, media and society content. The independently evidenced language-and-linguistics cluster supports a distinct cognition-and-communication programme. Together they account for all generator-eligible rows. The remaining curricular topics strengthen these two directions but do not independently generate a third coherent UCR curriculum. Production therefore stops at two; neither programme is presented as Spanish Language and Culture.

notes.text: Radboud Spanish Language and Culture combines progressive Spanish proficiency, Spanish-medium study, Hispanic linguistics, literature and cultural analysis, required study in a Spanish-speaking country and a Hispanic-studies thesis. UCR can construct programmes in literature, media and global cultural politics or in language, cognition and public communication. These are related-fields responses: UCR does not offer Spanish-language instruction, a Hispanic-area sequence or Spanish-medium academic study.
